title: The Bengaluru Waste and Brand Audit: Accountability and Best Practices
summary: This C40 case study describes “The Bengaluru Waste and Brand Audit: Accountability and Best Practices,” an urban initiative documented for Bengaluru. It is included because it is located in the Global South. intervention.objectives: The Bengaluru Waste and Brand Audit is a great example of civil society engagement in solid waste management, happening in the capital of India’s southern Karnataka state. The Audit aimed to highlight and scale up the responsibility of brand owners, manufacturers and producers of plastic packaging with regards to the implementation of waste collection systems.
